Wachusett NEMBA Monday Night Ride

Leominster, MA · Mountain bike

Wachusett NEMBA Monday Night Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Leominster, MA. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Changes weekly; Oct 5: Leominster State Forest, Elm St lot.

For visitors

Register on the chapter's NEMBA event page. Seven Hills Wheelmen also lists the ride, starting Apr 20, 2026, and sends riders to the chapter's Facebook page.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wachusett NEMBA Monday Night Ride group ride

The Wachusett chapter of the New England Mountain Bike Association rides a different trail in north-central Massachusetts each Monday evening. The October list covers Leominster, Lunenburg, Holden and Rutland.
